exit_code_legend.scope: THIS batch only (harness rcs); product rcs are recorded raw and are NOT this legend

harness_rc.0: harness command completed and its evidence file was written (business verdict lives inside the evidence JSON)
harness_rc.1: harness failure: import error, evidence not written
harness_rc.2: no verdict / usage: required argument or precondition missing before judging
harness_rc.3: not as expected: a frozen comparison of this batch failed (outcome bytes differ, iso copy not byte-identical, family outcomes differ, live pins drifted)
